title: Citation policy per site and Story type, plus the free sources checklist step
description: First slice. Per-site citation policy saved as data (a Story procedure profile doctrine, like the visual style profile; no policy = warn and continue). Free code-only step, runs on every save: every [@key] is a current accepted Reference linked to the Story; citation style follows the policy for the Story type (Machines on Machines: numbered superscripts plus reference list, phrase links only for internal pages; post: one direct source link); links answer; no cited source copied closely. Findings to S3, counts on the checklist. No triggers, no model calls. Design: ~/Projects/knowledge-runs/architecture/story-automation-design-20261108.md
